name: console/configure-connections
setup: handbook, plus a connection group clinics with one member northside, and both connections tested so that one shows Reached and one Failed (the supplier's address answers 404)
ready: the Connections table is listed and the Connection groups section is below it
mask: the tested-ago text in the Health column
alt: The Connections screen: a table of connections with their health, what uses them, their kind and where they point, and the Connection groups section below it.

name: console/configure-connection-sheet
setup: handbook; in Sandbox, an HTTP connection stock-prices at the stand-in's address with a token, saved and tested
ready: the sheet shows Saved and Reached
steps: type the name stock-prices, the address and the token, choose Authorization: Bearer
press Save and wait for the result
alt: The sheet for a new HTTP connection after Save: the name stock-prices, the address, the stored token with Replace and Remove, and the results Saved and Reached.

name: console/configure-variables
setup: handbook, with one variable set to a value, one set to an empty value and one on its default
alt: The Variables screen: a table of variables with what reads each, what it is for, and its value here, which is a set value, Empty, or Default followed by the default.

name: console/configure-secrets
setup: handbook, plus two secrets (the seeded PAYFERN_SIGNING_SECRET and SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT)
alt: The Secrets screen: a table with each secret's name, what uses it, and when and by whom it was last set, with a Delete button in each row.

name: console/configure-alerts
setup: handbook, with the default alert posting to an HTTP connection and one failed run that was alerted
ready: the Recent alerts list is shown
alt: The Alerts screen: the workspace's default, with a script to start and a connection to post to, then the list of recent alerts.
